name: Momo no Hana wa Senketsu ni Somaru
original_name: 桃の華は鮮血に染まる
source: Onmyoji - A girl who is hailed as a genius in onmyojutsu. A girl who excels in swordsmanship. A girl who excels in onmyojutsu and martial arts. Three sisters called the Onmyo girls face their harsh fates. The definitive Japanese-style dark visual novel is now available! This game contains gore such as human body defects and bloodshed. You can read through this brutal world infested with demons as if it were a novel.
translation: 阴阳师——一位被誉为阴阳术天才的少女，一位精通剑术的少女，以及一位兼擅阴阳术与武艺的少女。被称为“阴阳少女”的三姐妹，将面对残酷的命运。和风黑暗视觉小说的决定之作，现已登场！本作包含肢体残缺、流血等血腥表现。你将如同阅读小说一般，走进这个妖魔横行的残酷世界。
